lead: Mentions: type a trigger character (`@` by default) in the input and a list of candidates opens next to the caret. Arrow keys move through it, <kbd>Enter</kbd> or <kbd>Tab</kbd> confirms, <kbd>Esc</kbd> closes. The value is plain text: to know who was mentioned, parse it yourself by prefix.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `mentions.css`; the input's look comes from `input.css`.
styling.root: The outer wrapper; the input inside is the theme style's own input / textarea
styling.list: The candidate list in the popup next to the caret, `role=listbox`
styling.option: Each candidate, `role=option`; `data-active` when highlighted by keyboard or mouse, `data-disabled` when disabled
